item.question:
Create a solution at 15 degrees C with 5.0 mmol/kgw of C(-4). Set a gas phase at fixed pressure of 1.0, 15 degrees C, and 0 CH4(g).

What is the molality of CO2 in solution?

A. 6.279e-10
B. 6.278e-10
C. 6.277e-10
D. 6.273e-10
item.author: sc

function.arguments:
{"path":"input.pqi","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 15
    units mmol/kgw
    C(-4) 5.0

GAS_PHASE 1
    -fixed_pressure
    -pressure 1.0
    -temperature 15
    CH4(g) 0

SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
USER_PUNCH
    -headings m_CO2
    10 PUNCH MOL("CO2")
END
"}
